/privacy/.title: Privacy Notice | Ez Kyosk
/privacy/.description: Read how the Ez Kyosk website handles local-review inquiry information and which details must be confirmed before production inquiry processing is enabled.
text: Information shown in the inquiry form

The form asks for a name, email address, business type, requirements message, and optional business name and phone number. In the default local-review configuration, this information stays in the browser and is not submitted by Ez Kyosk.

The intended purpose is to receive product-demo and business-requirement inquiries. Production processing will not be enabled until the owner approves the form provider, processing purpose, privacy contact, retention period, and request-handling procedures.

A production hosting provider may process technical request information, such as an IP address, requested URL, browser details, and timestamps, to deliver and secure the website. The provider and applicable retention terms will be named before launch.

Website fonts are served locally. No analytics, advertising pixels, embedded videos, or non-essential cookie tools are enabled in this repository. If those tools are adopted later, this notice and any required consent controls must be updated first.

The responsible business identity, privacy contact, response procedure, and retention schedule are pending owner and legal confirmation. Those details must be added before production inquiry collection begins.
Do not enter sensitive, confidential, payment, medical, or identity-document information into the preview form. Use test information only while reviewing the website locally.
